verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog says teams can create documents from their home page, attach existing documents to projects and issues, and group resources into sections. It also documents creating and editing documents on mobile, callouts in documents, and loops that keep project documents current, so the product itself delivers shared docs alongside project work. One older community comment cites 'no Confluence equivalent', which suggests limited wiki depth rather than contradicting the feature. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on document organization and sharing permissions, independent or hands-on corroboration, evidence of wiki-style depth such as nested page hierarchies.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can create and organize shared docs and notes alongside my project work

citations.quote: Teams can create documents directly from their home page, add existing documents from projects and issues, and group resources into sections.
Document creation and editing are now available in Linear's iOS and Android apps.
Use callout components to draw attention to important information in issue and project descriptions, as well as documents.
When scope or timing changes, a loop can update the relevant Linear document so plans stay aligned.
